## Specification

### Component: Command (command palette)

A searchable list of pages and actions. `Command` is inline; `CommandDialog` puts it in the Dialog, top-aligned, with an optional ⌘K / Ctrl+K hotkey.

#### Anatomy
```
<Command>                          <div class="ui-command"> context: search, highlight, filter
  <CommandInput />                 .ui-command-input-wrap: search icon + <input role="combobox">
  <CommandList>                    <div class="ui-command-list" role="listbox"> max-height 22rem, scrolls
    <CommandEmpty />               .ui-command-empty (role="status") only when a search has no match
    <CommandGroup heading="…">     role="group" aria-labelledby heading; hidden when it has no match
      <CommandItem />              .ui-command-item role="option" aria-selected; .ui-command-icon .ui-command-label .ui-command-shortcut
    <CommandSeparator />           hidden while searching
  <CommandFooter />                key hints, .ui-command-footer
<CommandDialog>                    Dialog > DialogContent.ui-command-dialog + hidden DialogTitle + Command
```

#### Props
- `Command`: `search`, `defaultSearch`, `onSearchChange`, `shouldFilter` (true), `filter(value, search, keywords) => number`, `label`, `onItemSelect`.
- `CommandInput`: input props (`placeholder` default "Type a command or search…"); `data-autofocus` so a Dialog focuses it.
- `CommandItem`: `value` (search text, default the item text), `keywords: string[]`, `icon`, `shortcut` (a string becomes `Kbd` key caps, or a node), `disabled`, `onSelect(value)`.
- `CommandGroup`: `heading`. `CommandEmpty`: children (default "No results found.").
- `CommandDialog`: `open`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange`, `hotkey` (false), `closeOnSelect` (true), `title` (visually hidden, "Command palette"), `description`, plus `Command` props.

#### Behaviour
- Scoring (`commandScore`): label exact 100, prefix 90, word start 70, substring 50; keywords prefix 60, word start 55, substring 30; every word of a multi-word search found in label + keywords 20; else 0 (hidden). Empty search matches all.
- Ranking: inside a group, better matches float to the top (CSS `order: −score`); on every search change the best-scoring option overall is highlighted and the list scrolls to the top. Without a search the first enabled item is highlighted.
- Focus stays in the input. `↓`/`↑` move the highlight (visual order, wrapping, skipping disabled); `Home`/`End` first/last; `Enter` runs the highlighted item (click on it); pointer hover moves the highlight (not touch); `mousedown` in the list does not blur the input. Keyboard moves scroll the item into view (`nearest`).
- Running an item calls `onSelect(value)` then `onItemSelect`; `CommandDialog` closes (unless `closeOnSelect={false}`). The dialog unmounts its content on close, so the search resets.
- `hotkey`: `Ctrl/⌘ + K` anywhere toggles the dialog and prevents the browser default.

#### Visual rules
- Command: 1px `--ui-border`, `--radius-xl`, `--ui-surface-raised`; in the dialog no border/radius/background (panel padding 0, max-width 40rem, size lg).
- Input row 48px high, 16px side padding, 1px bottom border, 18px muted search icon; input font 16px on coarse pointers.
- List padding 4px. Item 36px high, padding 0 8px, gap 10px, `--radius-md`; highlighted: `--ui-accent` / `--ui-accent-foreground`; disabled 50% opacity. Heading 12px / 500 muted, padding 8px 8px 4px.
- Footer: 12px muted on `--ui-surface-muted`, 1px top border, gap 16px.
- Dialog sits at `min(18dvh, 8rem)` from the top (8px on phones), never docked to the bottom.

#### Motion
- Dialog: the standard soft rise (overlay fade 220ms, panel `ui-pop-in` 380ms). Highlight tint 100ms; no list animation, so typing never lags.

#### Accessibility
- Input: `role="combobox"`, `aria-expanded="true"`, `aria-autocomplete="list"`, `aria-controls` = listbox (omitted when nothing matches), `aria-activedescendant` = highlighted option.
- With no match the list drops its `listbox` role (a listbox needs options) and shows the status message.
- Dialog: modal with a hidden title, focus in the field on open, returns to the opener on close.

#### Acceptance checks
- Typing "dark mode" leaves one item (keyword match); "zzz" shows the empty message and removes the listbox.
- "inv" ranks "Invite teammate" above "Download invoices" and highlights it.
- ↓/↑/Home/End/Enter work with focus in the field; disabled items are skipped.
- ⌘K / Ctrl+K toggles the dialog; Esc closes and focus returns to the button; search is empty on reopen.
- No serious axe violations in the open dialog.

### `ui/components/command/command-context.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { createContext, isValidElement, useCallback, useContext, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';

export type CommandFilter = (value: string, search: string, keywords: string[]) => number;

export interface CommandContextValue {
  search: string;
  setSearch: (search: string) => void;
  shouldFilter: boolean;
  filter: CommandFilter;
  listId: string;
  inputId: string;
  activeId: string | null;
  setActiveId: (id: string | null) => void;
  /** Items register while they match, so groups and the empty state know what is visible. */
  register: (id: string) => () => void;
  /** No visible item while a search is typed. */
  empty: boolean;
  /** Called after an item runs (CommandDialog closes itself here). */
  onItemSelect?: (value: string) => void;
}

export const CommandContext = createContext<CommandContextValue | null>(null);

export function useCommandContext(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(CommandContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <Command>.`);
  return ctx;
}

/** A group tracks its own visible items so it can hide when a search leaves it empty. */
export interface CommandGroupContextValue {
  register: (id: string) => () => void;
}

export const CommandGroupContext = createContext<CommandGroupContextValue | null>(null);

/** Counts the ids that registered themselves. */
export function useVisibleCount() {
  const ids = useRef(new Set<string>());
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const register = useCallback((id: string) => {
    ids.current.add(id);
    setCount(ids.current.size);
    return () => {
      ids.current.delete(id);
      setCount(ids.current.size);
    };
  }, []);
  return { count, register };
}

/** Plain text of a React node: the default search value of an item. */
export function textOf(node: ReactNode): string {
  if (node == null || typeof node === 'boolean') return '';
  if (typeof node === 'string' || typeof node === 'number') return String(node);
  if (Array.isArray(node)) return node.map(textOf).join('');
  if (isValidElement(node)) return textOf((node.props as { children?: ReactNode }).children);
  return '';
}

const OPTIONS = '[role="option"]:not([aria-disabled="true"])';

/** Enabled options in the order they appear on screen (ranking can reorder them with CSS). */
export function visualOptions(root: HTMLElement): HTMLElement[] {
  return Array.from(root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(OPTIONS))
    .map((el, i) => ({ el, i, top: el.getBoundingClientRect().top }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.top - b.top || a.i - b.i)
    .map((x) => x.el);
}
```

### `ui/components/command/command-dialog.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogTitle } from '../dialog/dialog';
import { Command, type CommandProps } from './command';

export interface CommandDialogProps extends Omit<CommandProps, 'onItemSelect'> {
  /** Controlled open state. */
  open?: boolean;
  /** Initial open state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  /** Called when the palette asks to open or close. */
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** Toggle with ⌘K (macOS) or Ctrl+K anywhere on the page. Default false. */
  hotkey?: boolean;
  /** Close after an item runs. Default true. */
  closeOnSelect?: boolean;
  /** Name announced when the dialog opens (visually hidden). Default "Command palette". */
  title?: string;
  /** Hidden hint read after the title. */
  description?: string;
  /** Class for the dialog layer. */
  dialogClassName?: string;
  children?: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * CommandDialog — the command palette as a modal: a Command inside our Dialog,
 * aligned to the top of the screen and wider than a normal dialog. The search
 * field is focused on open and the search is cleared when it closes.
 */
export function CommandDialog({
  open: openProp,
  defaultOpen = false,
  onOpenChange,
  hotkey = false,
  closeOnSelect = true,
  title = 'Command palette',
  description,
  dialogClassName,
  className,
  children,
  ...commandProps
}: CommandDialogProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useControllableState({ value: openProp, defaultValue: defaultOpen, onChange: onOpenChange });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hotkey) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey) && !e.altKey && !e.shiftKey && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setOpen((prev) => !prev);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [hotkey, setOpen]);

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <DialogContent
        centered
        showClose={false}
        size="lg"
        className={cn('ui-command-dialog', dialogClassName)}
        panelClassName="ui-command-dialog-panel"
      >
        <DialogTitle className="ui-command-title">{title}</DialogTitle>
        {description && <DialogDescription className="ui-command-title">{description}</DialogDescription>}
        <Command className={className} onItemSelect={closeOnSelect ? () => setOpen(false) : undefined} {...commandProps}>
          {children}
        </Command>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```

### `ui/components/command/command-filter.ts`

```ts
/* Search scoring for the command palette. Higher is a better match, 0 is no match.
   Tiers, best first: exact, prefix, word start, substring of the label; then the
   same tiers on keywords (always below a label prefix); finally every word of a
   multi-word search found somewhere in label + keywords. */

const WORD_BREAK = /[\s\-_/.:,]/;

function tier(haystack: string, q: string): 'exact' | 'prefix' | 'word' | 'substring' | null {
  if (haystack === q) return 'exact';
  if (haystack.startsWith(q)) return 'prefix';
  const at = haystack.indexOf(q);
  if (at === -1) return null;
  // a word start: the match begins right after a separator
  let i = at;
  while (i !== -1) {
    if (i === 0 || WORD_BREAK.test(haystack[i - 1] ?? '')) return 'word';
    i = haystack.indexOf(q, i + 1);
  }
  return 'substring';
}

const LABEL_SCORE = { exact: 100, prefix: 90, word: 70, substring: 50 } as const;
const KEYWORD_SCORE = { exact: 65, prefix: 60, word: 55, substring: 30 } as const;

/** Score `value` (and its `keywords`) against `search`. An empty search matches everything. */
export function commandScore(value: string, search: string, keywords: string[] = []): number {
  const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!q) return 1;
  const label = value.toLowerCase();
  const words = keywords.map((k) => k.toLowerCase());

  let best = 0;
  const l = tier(label, q);
  if (l) best = LABEL_SCORE[l];
  for (const k of words) {
    const t = tier(k, q);
    if (t) best = Math.max(best, KEYWORD_SCORE[t]);
  }
  if (best) return best;

  const tokens = q.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (tokens.length > 1) {
    const all = [label, ...words].join(' ');
    if (tokens.every((t) => all.includes(t))) return 20;
  }
  return 0;
}
```

### `ui/components/command/command.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  forwardRef,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useId,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  type ChangeEvent,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type InputHTMLAttributes,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type MouseEvent,
  type PointerEvent,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { Kbd, KbdGroup } from '../kbd/kbd';
import { commandScore } from './command-filter';
import {
  CommandContext,
  CommandGroupContext,
  textOf,
  useCommandContext,
  useVisibleCount,
  visualOptions,
  type CommandFilter,
} from './command-context';

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface CommandProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Controlled search text. */
  search?: string;
  /** Initial search text when uncontrolled. */
  defaultSearch?: string;
  /** Called when the search text changes. */
  onSearchChange?: (search: string) => void;
  /** Filter and rank items by the search. Set false to filter yourself (async results). Default true. */
  shouldFilter?: boolean;
  /** Custom scorer: return 0 to hide an item, higher to rank it first. */
  filter?: CommandFilter;
  /** Accessible name of the whole palette. */
  label?: string;
  /** Called after an item runs. */
  onItemSelect?: (value: string) => void;
}

/**
 * Command — a searchable list of actions. The input keeps focus; arrows move
 * a highlight through the list (aria-activedescendant) and Enter runs it.
 * Items are filtered and ranked: prefix, then word start, then substring,
 * with keywords counting too.
 */
export const Command = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, CommandProps>(function Command(
  {
    search: searchProp,
    defaultSearch = '',
    onSearchChange,
    shouldFilter = true,
    filter = commandScore,
    label,
    onItemSelect,
    className,
    onKeyDown,
    ...props
  },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useControllableState({ value: searchProp, defaultValue: defaultSearch, onChange: onSearchChange });
  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useControllableState<string | null>({ defaultValue: null });
  const id = useId();
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, rootRef);
  const { count, register } = useVisibleCount();
  const prevSearch = useRef(search);
  const scrollNext = useRef(false);

  const searching = search.trim() !== '';
  const empty = searching && count === 0;

  // After every render: a new search highlights the top match; a vanished item is replaced
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    const root = rootRef.current;
    if (!root) return;
    const options = visualOptions(root);
    if (prevSearch.current !== search) {
      prevSearch.current = search;
      const list = root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-command-list]');
      if (list) list.scrollTop = 0;
      // The best match overall (groups sit in DOM order, so the first row is not always it)
      const best = options.reduce<HTMLElement | undefined>(
        (top, el) => (!top || Number(el.dataset.score ?? 0) > Number(top.dataset.score ?? 0) ? el : top),
        undefined,
      );
      setActiveId(best?.id ?? null);
    } else if (!activeId || !options.some((el) => el.id === activeId)) {
      setActiveId(options[0]?.id ?? null);
    }
  });

  // Keyboard moves keep the highlight in view; hover moves don't scroll
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeId || !scrollNext.current) return;
    scrollNext.current = false;
    document.getElementById(activeId)?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
  }, [activeId]);

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({
      search,
      setSearch,
      shouldFilter,
      filter,
      listId: `${id}-list`,
      inputId: `${id}-input`,
      activeId,
      setActiveId,
      register,
      empty,
      onItemSelect,
    }),
    [search, setSearch, shouldFilter, filter, id, activeId, setActiveId, register, empty, onItemSelect],
  );

  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    onKeyDown?.(e);
    if (e.defaultPrevented || e.nativeEvent.isComposing) return;
    const root = rootRef.current;
    if (!root) return;
    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      // Enter belongs to buttons and links inside the palette; elsewhere it runs the highlight
      if (target.closest('button, a')) return;
      const el = activeId ? document.getElementById(activeId) : null;
      if (el) {
        e.preventDefault();
        el.click();
      }
      return;
    }
    if (!['ArrowDown', 'ArrowUp', 'Home', 'End'].includes(e.key)) return;
    const options = visualOptions(root);
    if (!options.length) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const i = options.findIndex((el) => el.id === activeId);
    let next: HTMLElement | undefined;
    if (e.key === 'Home') next = options[0];
    else if (e.key === 'End') next = options[options.length - 1];
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') next = options[(i + 1) % options.length];
    else next = options[(i <= 0 ? options.length : i) - 1];
    scrollNext.current = true;
    setActiveId(next?.id ?? null);
  };

  return (
    <CommandContext.Provider value={value}>
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role={label ? 'group' : undefined}
        aria-label={label}
        className={cn('ui-command', className)}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        {...props}
      />
    </CommandContext.Provider>
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface CommandInputProps extends Omit<InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'value' | 'defaultValue' | 'type'> {
  /** Class for the wrapper that holds the icon and the field. */
  wrapperClassName?: string;
}

/** The search field, with a search icon. */
export const CommandInput = forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, CommandInputProps>(function CommandInput(
  { className, wrapperClassName, onChange, placeholder = 'Type a command or search…', ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useCommandContext('CommandInput');
  return (
    <div className={cn('ui-command-input-wrap', wrapperClassName)}>
      <Icon name="search" className="ui-command-input-icon" />
      <input
        ref={ref}
        id={ctx.inputId}
        type="text"
        role="combobox"
        aria-expanded="true"
        aria-autocomplete="list"
        aria-controls={ctx.empty ? undefined : ctx.listId}
        aria-activedescendant={ctx.activeId ?? undefined}
        aria-label={props['aria-label'] ?? placeholder}
        autoComplete="off"
        autoCorrect="off"
        autoCapitalize="off"
        spellCheck={false}
        data-autofocus=""
        placeholder={placeholder}
        value={ctx.search}
        className={cn('ui-command-input', className)}
        onChange={(e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
          onChange?.(e);
          ctx.setSearch(e.target.value);
        }}
        {...props}
      />
    </div>
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface CommandListProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {}

/** Scrolling list of groups and items. Put `CommandEmpty` inside it. */
export const CommandList = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, CommandListProps>(function CommandList(
  { className, onMouseDown, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useCommandContext('CommandList');
  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      id={ctx.listId}
      // With nothing to choose, the empty message is not a listbox (a listbox needs options)
      role={ctx.empty ? undefined : 'listbox'}
      aria-label={ctx.empty ? undefined : (props['aria-label'] ?? 'Suggestions')}
      data-command-list=""
      className={cn('ui-command-list', className)}
      onMouseDown={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onMouseDown?.(e);
        // Keep focus in the input when an item is pressed
        if (!e.defaultPrevented) e.preventDefault();
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface CommandEmptyProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {}

/** Shown when a search leaves no item. */
export const CommandEmpty = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, CommandEmptyProps>(function CommandEmpty(
  { className, children = 'No results found.', ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useCommandContext('CommandEmpty');
  if (!ctx.empty) return null;
  return (
    <div ref={ref} role="status" className={cn('ui-command-empty', className)} {...props}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface CommandGroupProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'heading'> {
  /** Small label above the group. */
  heading?: ReactNode;
}

/** A labelled group of items. It hides itself when a search leaves it empty. */
export const CommandGroup = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, CommandGroupProps>(function CommandGroup(
  { heading, className, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useCommandContext('CommandGroup');
  const id = useId();
  const { count, register } = useVisibleCount();
  const group = useMemo(() => ({ register }), [register]);
  const hidden = ctx.search.trim() !== '' && count === 0;
  return (
    <CommandGroupContext.Provider value={group}>
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="group"
        aria-labelledby={heading != null ? `${id}-heading` : undefined}
        hidden={hidden}
        className={cn('ui-command-group', className)}
        {...props}
      >
        {heading != null && (
          <div id={`${id}-heading`} aria-hidden="true" className="ui-command-heading">
            {heading}
          </div>
        )}
        {children}
      </div>
    </CommandGroupContext.Provider>
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface CommandItemProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'onSelect'> {
  /** What the search matches against. Defaults to the item's text. */
  value?: string;
  /** Extra words that find this item ("dark mode" for Appearance). */
  keywords?: string[];
  /** Leading icon (16px). */
  icon?: ReactNode;
  /** Shortcut hint on the right: a string such as "⌘K" becomes key caps, or pass your own node. */
  shortcut?: ReactNode;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Runs when the item is chosen (click or Enter). */
  onSelect?: (value: string) => void;
}

/** One selectable result. */
export const CommandItem = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, CommandItemProps>(function CommandItem(
  { value, keywords, icon, shortcut, disabled, onSelect, onClick, onPointerMove, className, style, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useCommandContext('CommandItem');
  const group = useContext(CommandGroupContext);
  const id = useId();
  const text = value ?? textOf(children);
  const searching = ctx.shouldFilter && ctx.search.trim() !== '';
  const score = searching ? ctx.filter(text, ctx.search, keywords ?? []) : 1;
  const visible = score > 0;
  const { register } = ctx;
  const registerGroup = group?.register;

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!visible) return;
    const a = register(id);
    const b = registerGroup?.(id);
    return () => {
      a();
      b?.();
    };
  }, [visible, id, register, registerGroup]);

  const select = useCallback(() => {
    onSelect?.(text);
    ctx.onItemSelect?.(text);
  }, [onSelect, ctx, text]);

  if (!visible) return null;
  const active = ctx.activeId === id;

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      id={id}
      role="option"
      aria-selected={active}
      aria-disabled={disabled || undefined}
      data-selected={active ? '' : undefined}
      data-score={searching ? score : undefined}
      data-disabled={disabled ? '' : undefined}
      className={cn('ui-command-item', className)}
      // Better matches float to the top of their group
      style={searching ? { order: -score, ...style } : style}
      onPointerMove={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onPointerMove?.(e);
        if (e.pointerType !== 'touch' && !disabled && !active) ctx.setActiveId(id);
      }}
      onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onClick?.(e);
        if (!e.defaultPrevented && !disabled) select();
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      {icon != null && <span className="ui-command-icon">{icon}</span>}
      <span className="ui-command-label">{children}</span>
      {shortcut != null && (
        <span className="ui-command-shortcut">
          {typeof shortcut === 'string' ? (
            <KbdGroup>
              {Array.from(shortcut.replace(/\s+/g, '')).map((key, i) => (
                <Kbd key={i} size="sm">
                  {key}
                </Kbd>
              ))}
            </KbdGroup>
          ) : (
            shortcut
          )}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/** A hairline between groups. Hidden while a search is typed. */
export const CommandSeparator = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function CommandSeparator(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useCommandContext('CommandSeparator');
  if (ctx.search.trim() !== '') return null;
  return <div ref={ref} role="separator" className={cn('ui-command-separator', className)} {...props} />;
});

/** Key hints along the bottom edge: "↑↓ navigate  ↵ select  esc close". */
export const CommandFooter = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function CommandFooter(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-command-footer', className)} {...props} />;
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect } from 'react';

/** useLayoutEffect in the browser, useEffect on the server (no SSR warning). */
export const useIsomorphicLayoutEffect = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? useLayoutEffect : useEffect;
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/command.css`

```css
/* Command palette ---------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-command">
     .ui-command-input-wrap > svg.ui-command-input-icon + input.ui-command-input
     .ui-command-list [role=listbox]
       .ui-command-group [role=group] > .ui-command-heading + items
       .ui-command-item [role=option] [aria-selected] [data-disabled]
          .ui-command-icon .ui-command-label .ui-command-shortcut
       .ui-command-separator  .ui-command-empty
     .ui-command-footer
   Dialog: .ui-dialog.ui-command-dialog > .ui-dialog-panel.ui-command-dialog-panel
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-command {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    background: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    color: var(--ui-surface-raised-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-base);
  }

  .ui-command-input-wrap {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    height: 3rem;
    padding-inline: 1rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
  }
  .ui-command-input-icon { flex-shrink: 0; width: 1.125rem; height: 1.125rem; color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }
  .ui-command-input {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    height: 100%;
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    color: inherit;
    font: inherit;
    outline: none;
  }
  .ui-command-input::placeholder { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); opacity: 1; }
  .ui-command-input-wrap:focus-within { box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 0 var(--ui-ring); }
  /* iOS Safari zooms into inputs under 16px */
  @media (pointer: coarse) {
    .ui-command-input { font-size: max(16px, var(--text-base)); }
  }

  .ui-command-list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    max-height: 22rem;
    padding: 4px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    scroll-padding-block: 4px;
  }

  .ui-command-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
  .ui-command-group[hidden] { display: none; }
  .ui-command-group + .ui-command-group,
  .ui-command-separator + .ui-command-group { margin-top: 2px; }
  .ui-command-heading {
    order: -1000;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.5rem 0.25rem;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    line-height: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .ui-command-item {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.625rem;
    min-height: 2.25rem;
    padding: 0 0.5rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    color: inherit;
    line-height: 1.25rem;
    cursor: default;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition: background-color var(--ui-duration-instant) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-command-item[aria-selected="true"] {
    background: var(--ui-accent);
    color: var(--ui-accent-foreground);
  }
  .ui-command-item[data-disabled] { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

  .ui-command-icon { display: inline-flex; flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }
  .ui-command-icon > svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; }
  .ui-command-item[aria-selected="true"] .ui-command-icon { color: inherit; }
  .ui-command-label { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
  .ui-command-shortcut { display: inline-flex; flex-shrink: 0; margin-inline-start: auto; }

  .ui-command-separator { height: 1px; margin: 4px -4px; background: var(--ui-border); }

  .ui-command-empty {
    padding: 2rem 1rem;
    text-align: center;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
  }

  .ui-command-footer {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    background: var(--ui-surface-muted);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
  }
  .ui-command-footer > span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; }

  /* iOS Safari only dispatches click on elements that look clickable */
  @media (hover: none) {
    .ui-command-item { cursor: pointer; }
  }

  /* Dialog: top-aligned, wider, no panel chrome (the Command draws its own) */
  .ui-dialog.ui-command-dialog[open] {
    place-items: start center;
    padding-top: min(18dvh, 8rem);
  }
  .ui-dialog .ui-command-dialog-panel {
    gap: 0;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    max-width: 40rem;
  }
  .ui-command-dialog-panel .ui-command { border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; }
  .ui-command-dialog-panel .ui-command-list { max-height: min(22rem, 52dvh); }
  @media (max-width: 639px) {
    .ui-dialog.ui-command-dialog[open] { padding-top: 0.5rem; }
  }

  /* visually hidden dialog title / description */
  .ui-command-title {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    margin: -1px;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip-path: inset(50%);
    white-space: nowrap;
    border: 0;
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Command palette** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/command/palette.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { CommandDialog, CommandEmpty, CommandFooter, CommandGroup, CommandInput, CommandItem, CommandList, CommandSeparator } from '@/ui/components/command';
import { Kbd, KbdGroup } from '@/ui/components/kbd';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

export default function CommandPalette() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [last, setLast] = useState('Nothing run yet');
  const run = (value: string) => setLast(`Ran “${value}”`);

  return (
    <div className="grid justify-items-center gap-3">
      <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        <Icon name="search" />
        Search…
        <KbdGroup className="ml-2">
          <Kbd size="sm">⌘</Kbd>
          <Kbd size="sm">K</Kbd>
        </KbdGroup>
      </Button>
      <p role="status" className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
        {last}
      </p>

      <CommandDialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} hotkey title="Command palette">
        <CommandInput placeholder="Search pages, actions and settings…" />
        <CommandList>
          <CommandEmpty>No results found.</CommandEmpty>
          <CommandGroup heading="Pages">
            <CommandItem icon={<Icon name="home" />} onSelect={run}>
              Overview
            </CommandItem>
            <CommandItem icon={<Icon name="folder" />} keywords={['repositories', 'apps']} onSelect={run}>
              Projects
            </CommandItem>
            <CommandItem icon={<Icon name="bar-chart" />} keywords={['metrics', 'traffic']} onSelect={run}>
              Analytics
            </CommandItem>
          </CommandGroup>
          <CommandSeparator />
          <CommandGroup heading="Actions">
            <CommandItem icon={<Icon name="plus" />} shortcut="⌘N" keywords={['create']} onSelect={run}>
              New project
            </CommandItem>
            <CommandItem icon={<Icon name="copy" />} keywords={['link', 'share']} onSelect={run}>
              Copy preview link
            </CommandItem>
          </CommandGroup>
          <CommandSeparator />
          <CommandGroup heading="Settings">
            <CommandItem icon={<Icon name="sun" />} keywords={['theme', 'light mode', 'appearance']} onSelect={run}>
              Switch to light theme
            </CommandItem>
            <CommandItem icon={<Icon name="settings" />} shortcut="⌘," onSelect={run}>
              Preferences
            </CommandItem>
          </CommandGroup>
        </CommandList>
        <CommandFooter>
          <span>
            <Kbd size="sm">↑</Kbd>
            <Kbd size="sm">↓</Kbd> navigate
          </span>
          <span>
            <Kbd size="sm">↵</Kbd> select
          </span>
          <span>
            <Kbd size="sm">Esc</Kbd> close
          </span>
        </CommandFooter>
      </CommandDialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```
